title: React Frontend SPA Service

TASK-5.1.title: Create frontend Dockerfile with Node 20
TASK-5.1.notes: Dockerfile created with Node 20-alpine, npm ci for dependencies, CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING enabled, non-root user, port 3000 exposed.

TASK-5.2.title: Define frontend service in docker-compose.yml
TASK-5.2.notes: Frontend service added to docker-compose.yml with health checks, resource limits, depends_on backend, ports 3000:3000.

TASK-5.3.title: Configure volume mounting for HMR
TASK-5.3.notes: Bind mount configured: ./frontend:/app for hot reload. File watching enabled in Vite.

TASK-5.4.title: Optimize node_modules with named volume
TASK-5.4.notes: Named volume frontend_node_modules:/app/node_modules for better performance on Windows/macOS. Prevents node_modules from being overwritten by bind mount.

TASK-5.5.title: Initialize Vite + React project
TASK-5.5.notes: React 18+ with Vite 5+ initialized. Basic App component created with React hooks. Fast Refresh enabled.

TASK-5.6.title: Configure Vite dev server settings
TASK-5.6.notes: Vite configured with host: 0.0.0.0, port: 3000, file watching, HMR settings, path aliases (@/). Fast refresh enabled for React.

TASK-5.7.title: Configure API proxy to backend
TASK-5.7.notes: API proxy configured for /api routes to http://backend:8000. changeOrigin: true, secure: false. Proxy logging enabled for debugging.

TASK-5.8.title: Set up environment variable management
TASK-5.8.notes: Environment files created with VITE_ prefixed variables. config.js created for centralized env access. .env.frontend added to .gitignore.

TASK-5.9.title: Configure HMR and WebSocket settings
TASK-5.9.notes: HMR configured with protocol: ws, host: localhost, port: 3000, clientPort: 3000, overlay: true for error display. WebSocket configured for instant updates.

TASK-5.10.title: Enable source maps for debugging
TASK-5.10.notes: Source maps enabled in build config: sourcemap: true. Allows debugging original source code in browser devtools.

TASK-5.11.title: Test frontend service startup
TASK-5.11.notes: Integration test script created to verify: container running, HTTP 200 response, HTML contains React root element. Comprehensive error reporting and diagnostics included.

TASK-5.12.title: Test HMR functionality
TASK-5.12.notes: HMR test script created to verify: file changes detected, volume mounts correct, file watching enabled, HMR updates logged. Includes backup/restore mechanism and manual verification instructions.

TASK-5.13.title: Test API proxy and backend integration
TASK-5.13.notes: API proxy test script created to verify: backend reachable, proxy configuration present, API requests forwarded correctly, no CORS issues. Tests both direct backend and proxied requests.

TASK-5.14.title: Document frontend development workflow
TASK-5.14.notes: Comprehensive development guide created covering: quick start, development workflow, HMR usage, API calls, project structure, configuration, common commands, best practices. Over 500 lines of documentation.

TASK-5.15.title: Document troubleshooting guide
TASK-5.15.notes: Extensive troubleshooting guide created with 7 major sections: startup issues, HMR issues, API proxy issues, build/dependency issues, performance issues, Docker issues, cross-platform issues. Includes diagnostic commands and solutions for common problems.
